name: Waaagh!
text: Once per battle, at the start of any battle round, you may call a Waaagh!. Until the start of the next battle round, every model with this ability may charge in a turn its unit Advanced, fights with +1 Strength and +1 Attack on its melee weapons (not weapons with extra attacks), and gains a 5+ invulnerable save.

name: Dead 'ard
text: For as long as a Waaagh! is in effect, this model gains a 4+ Feel No Pain save.

name: Piston-driven Brutality
text: When the Fight phase begins, make every enemy unit within Engagement Range of a model with this ability take a Battle-shock test.
